data.body: Held-out TDD and live calibration evidence: the complete happy/edge/E2E oracle is GREEN (35 passed). Two wording defects in the held-out oracle were corrected under revert-first discipline: the implementation was removed, the corrected tests were reconfirmed RED, and the unchanged implementation was restored. A defect-seeded mutation changed the transient wildcard-admin eval expectation from finding to pass; the corpus test went RED because the balanced 5-pass/5-finding contract was violated, then returned GREEN after restoration. Live agentic evaluation used the documented audited local-experiment override (REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED=1) with three runs: n_fire=5, n_nofire=5, recall=1.0, false_accept=0.0, agreement=1.0, kappa=1.0, stability_min=1.0, stability_mean=1.0. All ten cases were correct and stable across all three runs.
